svg.title: Conditional allocation of purchased Z belt clamps
svg.desc: Original allocation diagram, not a verified assembly drawing. Proposed rear upper positions use the two top clamps from purchase 10, front upper positions use two clamps from the front-idler package 11, and all four lower functions use rigid joints from purchase 13. The two bottom clamps from purchase 10 are surplus. Two front-idler package clamps are surplus if four are supplied and this fit is confirmed.
svg.metadata: Original custom-guide schematic, GPL-3.0. Conditional allocation; physical interface geometry has not been verified.

g.text: Four upper captures + four integrated lower captures
CONDITIONAL ALLOCATION • not a physical assembly or belt-routing drawing • Gate M8 required
No hole or tooth geometry shown
Surplus: #10 bottom clamps × 2 (rigid joints replace that function).
Conditional surplus: #11 clamps × 2, only if four shipped and the proposed allocation fits.
Check 9 mm tooth width, hole spacing, screw engagement and package contents before capturing belts.
